claim: Compatibility slice only; no gate closes.
platform: Windows 11 x86 build (MSVC), private-desktop headless dedicated servers, no input
sourceUse: Retail executables read with capstone/pefile; id GPL Quake III, RTCW SP/MP and Enemy Territory sources and Quake3e used only to name routines (reference observation, no text incorporated).

stvoyHM.exe.runFrom: .tmp/runtime/stvef-retail (byte-identical copy, four retail paks as fs_cdpath)

quakelive_steam.exe.note: client only installed; no retail Quake Live server runs here

otherStores: save time in map_restart 0x430936 (not if negative)

keepsClock.method: Every store to each clock listed; every memset/rep stosd with an immediate base within 4 MiB of each clock listed: only the shutdown clear covers one.

quakelive_steam.exe.serverClock: svs.time 0x13337a4, cleared only by shutdown [0x13337a0,0x13e17e0) at 0x4e3ffa
quakelive_steam.exe.levelClock: sv.time 0x1333780, last field of the per-level block
quakelive_steam.exe.spawnOffset: every client in state >= 2 gets the old sv.time at +0x25b58, 0x4e35f0..0x4e3618
quakelive_steam.exe.spawnClear: [0x12e0340,0x1333784) memset at 0x4e363a..0x4e3646, covering sv.time, whoever is connected
quakelive_steam.exe.mapRestart: 0x4de670 returns while a restart is pending (0x4de6bb); otherwise every client in state >= 2 gets the pending restart time, always 0 there (0x4de869..0x4de89b)
quakelive_steam.exe.frameRestarts: idle restart past 24 h (0x4e4a7e) and stop past 0x70000000 (0x4e4ac2), on svs.time; no 12-hour level restart; no sv_levelTimeReset
quakelive_steam.exe.delayedRestart: counted on svs.time (0x4de71b..0x4de734, fired 0x4e4b01..0x4e4b13); configstring 5 written as an info string with time and g_gametype (0x4de727..0x4de7a8)

inheritedRule.jka-sp: open: jasp.exe clears its clock per spawn (0x439d0d); not examined
inheritedRule.jk2-sp: open: jk2sp.exe clears its clock per spawn (0x437226); not examined
